questions: Q1: Should PLAY replace EXECUTE in VALID_MODES or should both be accepted?
Q2: Does the CLI need new Play-specific subcommands for L1?
Q3: What CLI changes are needed for L2 and L3?

answers.answer: Replace EXECUTE with PLAY. The server will reject EXECUTE after the API validation update. Zero EXECUTE tickets exist — no backward-compatibility concern. Keeping both values would allow users to specify a mode the server rejects, creating a confusing failure experience.
evidence: Production DB (runtime-verified): 0 EXECUTE tickets across 852 total
Server ticketModeEnum will exclude EXECUTE after update

answers.answer: No. The CLI's ticket creation with --mode PLAY is sufficient for L1. The ticket description says 'Use normal Helix ticket system to create a Play'. Play-specific subcommands are deferred to L2/L3.
evidence: Ticket description item 1: 'Use normal Helix ticket system to create a Play'
Product spec: L1 scope is mode scaffolding, not execution
CLI is a thin client — server handles all mode-specific logic

answers.answer: L2: New play subcommands for preview (hlx plays preview --ticket <id>) and step definition. L3: Execution trigger (hlx plays run --ticket <id>), status check (hlx plays status), and execution output streaming. These follow the existing src/tickets/ pattern in a new src/plays/ directory. All deferred to their respective levels.
evidence: Product spec SCN-02: CLI creates PLAY ticket with --mode PLAY (L1 only)
src/tickets/ — existing pattern for ticket subcommands
L2/L3 CLI commands depend on server APIs that don't exist yet

statement: CLI needs a 2-file change for L1: replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES (create.ts:13) and docs (cli-content.ts:109). Smallest change of all repos. Deploy server first to avoid 400 rejections. L2/L3 add play-specific subcommands (hlx plays preview/run/status/list) in a new src/plays/ directory, deferred to their respective levels.
